product_title: Resin Shubh Pearl Embellished Decorative Hanging Set (3 inches)
product_description: Add an auspicious touch to your home with this elegant decorative hanging set featuring a white pearlescent finish, golden 'Shubh' lettering, delicate pearl embellishments, and gold-toned tassels. Perfect for Diwali, festive door décor, pooja rooms, and housewarming gifts.
product_care_suggestion: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid water, moisture, and harsh chemicals.
Handle the pearl details and tassels carefully.
Store in the provided box in a cool, dry place.
